correctness.rationale: Definitions, graph labelling and threshold-two update are exact. A monotonicity proof reduces forcing to the minimal seed, and explicit four-class seed trajectories identify exactly twenty forcing stars. Every pair extends to a nonforcing triple, so budget three is minimal. Two independent executable finite-state implementations exhaust all 120×128 labelled triple cases, reproduce the precise four basin/outcome/entry profiles, and detect actual first repeated states, not assumed period limits; their saved outputs have all assertions passed. Only a finite graph is claimed.

value.rationale: Pin-placement design is a motivated mathematical problem on a canonical highly symmetric, small, cubic graph. A sharp minimal zealot budget of three together with the exact twenty optimizers contrasts with triangle/path/wedge geometries, whose four exact consensus basin fractions and oscillatory populations are unexpectedly different. This gives a complete natural finite classification and reproducible benchmark, not an arbitrary low-information sample.
